summary: Jet.AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its special meeting to vote on a merger and spin-off. The transactions involve a merger between Jet.AI and flyExclusive, Inc., preceded by the spin-off of a subsidiary (SpinCo) via a Separation and Distribution Agreement. As of June 11, 2026, 34.2% of shares were represented, with ~99% of votes cast in favor, but approval requires a majority of outstanding shares, so the meeting was adjourned to June 23, 2026. The record date remains May 8, 2026. Stockholders who already voted need not act. Watch for shareholder turnout and the final vote outcome.
